name: ConfidenceBuilding

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on learning new languages.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on learning new languages and learning new cultures.

variations.context: Recovering confidence after making mistakes in a language class

setting.background: One learner became embarrassed after several public mistakes

scenario_template.topic: Talking about what happened in class
scenario_template.note: User1 feels they performed worse than expected

scenario_template.topic: Fear of speaking because of mistakes
scenario_template.note: They are tempted to stay quiet in future classes

scenario_template.topic: Finding a less stressful way to practice speaking
scenario_template.note: They ask for low-pressure practice ideas
Assistant suggests focusing on communication first

scenario_template.topic: Practicing a short conversation without interruption
scenario_template.note: They focus on keeping the conversation moving

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing only the most important mistakes
scenario_template.note: Assistant reframes errors as specific learning opportunities
User1 feels willing to speak again

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to learn and use a new language but has limited proficiency and can become overwhelmed when faced with unfamiliar vocabulary, grammar rules, pronunciation challenges, or too many concepts at once.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help plan and practice language learning, but tends to overthink grammar, double-check phrasing and pronunciation, and seek confirmation when unsure whether an expression is correct or natural.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Language-learning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for building vocabulary, understanding grammar, improving pronunciation, and practicing communication, adapts explanations and exercises to the user's proficiency level and goals, and offers corrections, examples, and alternative expressions when appropriate.
